cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('dev/fuzz2.py'); s = p.read_text()
old = """    if U > 1:
        k = rng.randint(1, min(maxr, U - 1))
        pts = rng.sample(range(1, U), k)
        # sometimes force adjacent points
        if rng.random() < 0.5 and U > 4:
            base = rng.randint(1, U - 4)
            extra = [base, base + 1, base + 2]
            pts = sorted(set(pts) | set(extra))
            pts = [p for p in pts if 1 <= p <= U - 1]
    else:
        pts = []
    return [0] + sorted(pts) + [U]"""
new = """    if U > 1:
        k = rng.randint(1, min(maxr - 3, U - 1))
        pts = set(rng.sample(range(1, U), k))
        # sometimes force adjacent points (width-1 ranges)
        if rng.random() < 0.5 and U > 4:
            base = rng.randint(1, U - 3)
            pts |= {base, base + 1, base + 2}
        pts = sorted(p for p in pts if 1 <= p <= U - 1)[:maxr - 1]
    else:
        pts = []
    return [0] + pts + [U]"""
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new)); print('ok')
